docs.question: Which 3 stations have the highest peak-hour shortage rate?
docs.answer: The three stations with the highest peak-hour shortage rate are Phibsborough Road (100%), Golden Lane (70.65%), and Portobello Road (59.88%).

docs.question: Compare the average number of available bikes in hours with precipitation versus dry hours.
docs.answer: Across the covered station-hours, the average available bikes were about 11.61 during hours with precipitation and about 11.83 during dry hours, so rainy hours had roughly 0.22 fewer available bikes on average. Hours with no weather data (about 7,540 observed minutes) averaged 11.97 bikes and were excluded from that comparison.
docs.sql: SELECT had_precipitation, SUM(avg_available_bikes * observed_minutes) / NULLIF(SUM(observed_minutes), 0) AS weighted_avg_bikes, SUM(observed_minutes) AS total_observed_minutes FROM marts.agg_station_hourly GROUP BY had_precipitation ORDER BY had_precipitation LIMIT 200
